title: Tacu Tacu
description: Tacu Tacu is a dish from Peru featuring white rice, yellow onion, garlic, canned white beans. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 22 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 8 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Pan-fry the prepared food from the previous stages on both sides until browned and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
